title: Comparar compiler de frontier contra oracle independiente
mission: Execute the production frontier-pressure compiler against independently specified oracle scenarios, reconcile any mismatch by identifying whether the defect is in the oracle expectation or compiler semantics, and materialize a bounded repair job for any confirmed compiler defect. Do not weaken expected values merely to make the implementation pass.
definition_of_done: Production computeFrontierPressure is exercised using equivalent inputs for each oracle scenario.
Nested compiler outputs are mapped to the oracle vocabulary and compared deterministically.
Every mismatch is classified as ORACLE_DEFECT, COMPILER_DEFECT, or SPEC_AMBIGUITY with exact evidence.
Confirmed oracle defects are superseded by an append-only corrected fixture; confirmed compiler defects create a bounded repair job with regression acceptance.
No production /w or Current/Human Accepted/Served promotion is implied.
